title: AI Labs — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

blocks.heading: What students explore in AI
paras: Students learn AI through guided experimentation, project work, and connections to real-world use cases.

groups.title: AI Fundamentals

groups.title: Data Practice
text: Cleaning, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data for practical decisions.

groups.title: Prototype Building
text: Student projects turn AI ideas into simple working tools, demos, and experiments.

groups.title: NLP & Chatbots

groups.title: Automation
